name: reactor-entrance-from-snapshot
description: #74 Tier 2, second link of the chain: start from the snapshot "reactor-entrance" that new-game-to-reactor-entrance kept earlier in this run (scenarios run in file name order), wait 2 s, and check that restoring the snapshot again in a new core instance and playing the same script ends in the same state (match_rerun: main RAM, and the picture when a new one arrived, compared by hash inside the sandbox, reported only as 1/0). snapshot_frames is the frames from power-on to reactor-entrance.
